entities.title: The name typed when resending a score is ignored
entities.summary: After a failed submission the form asks for a name again, but sends the first name whatever is typed.
entities.expected: When the score could not be sent, the retry either sends the name now in the form, or does not ask for one.
entities.observed: offerTable() shows askName("Send your score again? Your name:") and only checks whether it returned null (SKIP); the name returned is discarded, and submitGame() is called again with the names from before.
reproduction: Finish a one-player game with a score that makes the table, with the API unreachable.
Enter a name; the form returns saying the score could not be sent.
Type a different name and press ENTER once the API is back: the first name is on the table.
acceptanceCriteria: The name on the table is the one in the form when ENTER was last pressed, or the retry offers only TRY AGAIN and SKIP.

origin.description: Found while documenting Hivestorm's folders: offerTable's retry loop.
